Likely they want top five sorted by chronological among all artworks? But maybe they want top five from the same set? The phrasing: "then retrieve ranking top five artworks sorted by chronological." Then search lawsuits:

- For Microsoft, start_date="2018-01-01", location="New York", status="settled".
